title: German Resinous Pasta Bake
description: A hearty German-inspired pasta dish featuring resinous Russian ingredients.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic powder and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in onion jam and cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Add fir needles and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in black truffle oil and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, skillet mixture, and grated cheese.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional grated cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.
